summary: Correct minimal fix using None sentinel so fit's copy_X only overrides the init value when explicitly passed, resolving the silent-override bug exactly as proposed in the issue. Approach is idiomatic and backward-compatible.

issues.description: fit docstring for copy_X still documents old default 'True' without noting new None sentinel semantics (falls back to self.copy_X); a doc line update would be nice but not blocking.
